items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: I wrote quite a bit of music for Ida Ray(?) Hubbard(?), a girl White band.

ctx.x: What were you doing the rest of the time around New York?

Giggin' wherever we could find one, and hang around and write music. I wrote quite a bit of music for Ida Ray(?) Hubbard(?), a girl White band. Eddie Durham had the job writing for them, and he had me help him out. We'd fix arrangements, send them over there, and those girls would copy them off. The band would rehearse them and get them down, and they'd be gone, go out on the road for awhile. Then we gigged around in their (?) and make up a band, and take them to the Savoy Ballroom, play over there four or five…
